name: f3-balance-recombined-v1
hypothesis: F3 leads because its signal states and responses catch the two observed early-exit routes (weak-review dismissal, trust crisis after accumulated risk), but its Clear state is a one-line 'play balanced'; F1's balance priorities are the best tested default behaviour. Rebuilding both into one strict precedence (Protect > Risk > Review > Balance) gives F3's survival with better growth in quiet periods, so posterior Y and completion are at least F3's and Level/Skill/Network are higher; because the bundle is shorter than either parent (393 vs 483 and 486 words), it should avoid the P20 regression seen when rules were added to F1 (f1-review-risk-v1, 49.1 vs 56.2).
change: New single Skill rebuilt from both parents as one block, not concatenated. Kept from F3: turn loop with feedback read first, risk-signal list, Clear/Raised/Escalating states with step-down after a quiet quarter, Raised/Escalating responses, story preference for disclose/fix/close, weak-review factor plan with change-of-factor, check_latest_logs only for unexplained warnings. Kept from F1: Balance as the explicit default (lift weakest or falling of Skill, Network, Output), story filter against downsides on protected dimensions and for steady over large-with-lasting-cost gains, Energy spread and Health-costing actions only while Health is comfortable, main action covering gaps Energy missed and rotating, late-run caution. Merged: F3 Limits and F1 Act band into one Protect priority; F1's legacy-risk Energy step and post-C/D Output line are subsumed by Risk and Review. Dropped: F1 Act/Watch/Fine classification and its note format, F3 Outcome signal, 'apply the same rules all run', explicit pointers to energy_cost and remaining_energy.
predicted_behaviour: Notes start with Clear, Raised or Escalating plus the signal or the weakest dimension. In Clear quarters, Energy spread over at least two actions and rotating main actions, similar to F1 (more Network maintenance and Skill learning than F3). After a risk signal, Defuse legacy risk in the next Energy phase (Raised) or every Energy phase (Escalating), as in F3. After a C or D, main action aimed at one named factor until the next review, switching factor if the grade stays weak. Fewer quarters spent in Lay low and reduce risk than F3 when Health is not low. Completion rate at least F3's; higher end-of-run Level, Skill and Network than F3; risk-control dimension close to F3's.
refutation: Refuted if, on paired runs with the same actor, posterior Y is below F3-v1 by more than the decision margin, or completion rate falls, or trust-crisis or capability-dismissal exits rise relative to F3. Refuted as pointless if Y is not above F3 and the Clear-quarter action mix does not differ from F3's (then the F1 default adds nothing). Manipulation fails if notes do not carry the state label, Defuse does not follow risk signals within the next Energy phase, or Clear quarters do not show F1-like Energy spread; then the text is not being executed.
notes: Block-3 recombination child (F3 x F1) after the second block decision: F3 61.3, F1 56.2, f1-review-risk 49.1 (Haiku, 3 runs each). Skill text 393 words by wc -w including front matter (370 in the body), under the 400-word budget and shorter than both parents. No numbers, counts, calendar triggers or event names: grades S-D, the 0-10 Health/Dignity range and action names are published; 'a whole quarter' and 'next review' use only the published cadence. Skill renamed balanced-feedback because it is not a copy of either parent's Skill. Compliance lint_bundle: 0 findings. parents lists policy names, not registry ids.
